name: NPM Suite
description: Manage the allowlist of npm and Angular CLI commands that agents may run inside this project.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Commands
allowedCommands.description: Commands the agent may run from the project root. Add a command plus an optional note; anything not listed is off-limits. Agents match on exact string, so use the precise command form you want allowed.

npm run lint.value: Run the lint script if present.

npm run typecheck.value: Run the typecheck script if present.

npm run build.value: Build the project. Safe — produces artifacts in dist/ or build/ but does not modify source.

npm outdated.value: Show packages with newer versions available. Read-only.

ng build.value: Build the Angular project. Safe — produces artifacts in dist/ but does not modify source.
